The reconcile apply/stop hooks are the P09 data-plane extension point: until a real data plane is wired, ApplyDesired with a nil apply hook leaves PRESENT Forwards unchanged (OutcomeUnchanged) and never fabricates bind tuples.

The durable inbox FSM (RECEIVED->INTENT_PERSISTED->APPLYING->APPLIED|NACKED) is implemented and pinned at the localstate store level; P08 wires transport message receipt into the journal and drives claim/send/ack/receipt for results.

ReconcileOnce records deletion results only when a connection session exists (epoch>0, session!=""); without a session the tombstone and actor stop are still durable and the result is recorded once the session appears (P08 hello/high-water).
make test requires ANTINAT_DEDICATED_UID/GID=12001 for the P03 spike/sandbox package (pre-existing environmental prerequisite, same as P05/P06); the owned packages pass without it.
